meta.title: فرض الفصل الأول في اللغة الإنجليزية (النموذج 3)

paper:
Nadia is a pupil in second year at Ibn Khaldoun middle school. She always gets up at half past six. She has breakfast with her family and then she walks to school with her friend Rym. School starts at eight o'clock. Nadia likes maths and science, but she doesn't like history. At noon, she usually has lunch at the school canteen. In the evening, she does her homework and sometimes she helps her mother. She never goes to bed after ten o'clock.

(Text written by the site)

A. Reading comprehension (8 points)

1. True or false? a) Nadia goes to school by bus. b) She doesn't like history. c) She usually has lunch at home.

2. Answer: a) What time does Nadia get up? b) What does she do in the evening?

B. Mastery of language (6 points)

1. Put the verbs in the present simple: Rym (walk) to school. — They (study) English on Monday. — Nadia (not / like) history.

2. Order the words: always / I / my teeth / brush / .

3. Write the time in letters: 6:30 → … ; 8:00 → …

C. Written expression (6 points)

Write 5 sentences about your school day. Use: always, usually, sometimes, never and the time.
